title: The Sea of Monsters
author: Rick Riordan
summary: The second Percy Jackson book. When the magic that protects the demigod summer camp starts to fail, Percy and his friends sail into a sea of mythological monsters to find a legendary item that could save it.
readIf: you like quick, funny adventures that remix Greek myth with a modern twist for younger readers.
skipIf: you haven't read the first book, as the characters and rules are set up there.

pairings.reason: Another middle-grade series where the second act deepens the friendships and quietly raises the stakes.
A classic adventure with myth-flavoured creatures and a clear quest, in a calmer old-fashioned voice.
Another fast kids' fantasy with magical creatures, a hidden world and siblings thrown into danger.
